title: e-Invoice infographic: request an e-Invoice to keep expense records digitally
publication_date: Not stated (new on HASiL's e-Invoice infographics page 25/11/2026)
summary: New 'Info e-Invois' infographic, set at a gym counter: customers who want an e-Invoice should scan the QR code on the receipt and submit the request before the end of the month. HASiL states the benefit to taxpayers: e-Invoices help store expense records digitally and support the planned pre-filling of tax relief information in the individual income tax return form (when implemented in the future). The listed version is in Malay; an English version is available at the same address ending -EN.
